---
title: "keygen"

description: "Generate an Ed25519 key pair for signing shared remote cache entries"
---

The private key is printed to standard output once and is never stored by omni.
Run this where the output is not logged, and keep the key in the publishing
job's secret store, never in the repository.

## Usage

```bash
omni cache keygen
```

---

## Examples

```bash
omni cache keygen
```
